newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 7.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. Secretary of State Albright to visit the Middle East by the end of this month.
- Israel frees a Lebanese journalist after a month in jail.
- Two businessmen from Lebanon and Saudi Arabia to set up a $100 million tourism project in Beirut.
- Profits of firms listed on Jordan's bourse rose 25.7 percent in 1996, to 239 million dinars from 190 million a year earlier.
- Israeli prime minister rejects calls to ease siege on the West Bank and Gaza.
- Iranian president tells Oman's Sultan Qaboos: "I extend my hand to all Arabs especially those in the Gulf."
- Iran warns Azerbaijan against signing oil contracts with U.S. firms.
- Kuwait signs an agreement to build an oil pipeline in Tunisia.
